description: Replace exact text in a file on the remote machine. old_string must be unique unless replace_all is set. On a guarded fleet you must first ask the user and get their explicit agreement; only then set `confirm` to the fleet name.

confirm.description: Guarded fleets only: the fleet name, set only after the user explicitly agreed. Never set it on your own.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

new_string.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must be unique in the file unless replace_all is set.

path.description: File path on the remote machine: absolute, or relative to the workspace directory.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: edit
